title: Stock Market Rises 1.3%
subtitle: International Oil Price Hike Favors Brazil's Financial Market
excerpt: Market Reaches Highest Level in Almost Four Months
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The international oil price hike favored Brazil's financial market.

The dollar fell to R$ 5.15, and the stock market advanced over 1% and closed at its highest level in almost four months.

Market Performance

The stock market rose 1.3% and reached its highest level in almost four months.

With information from Agência Brasil.
